example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading Ltd, invoice NT-2026-0418 to Harbor Retail Ltd, dated 31 October 2026, under UK VAT. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

messages.text: Can you prepare an invoice to Harbor Retail for the racking job?
Yes. Before I read anything, I need some answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload the data?
Do you want me to prepare a new invoice, or check invoices you already issued?
Which customer, and what do I bill? I need the description, quantity, unit price and tax code of each line.
What is the invoice date? What is the tax point, and when did you deliver each line?
Which tax rules apply, and which fields and phrases must the invoice show? I never take this from your company's country.
Which tax rate applies to each line? Do your prices include tax? Do you round tax on each line or on the total?
What are the payment terms, the currency and the customer's PO? Where do the payment details come from?

messages.text: Use MosoFin. Prepare one invoice from Northbrook Trading Ltd to Harbor Retail Ltd. 10 storage racking units at £180 and 6 hours of installation at £65. Invoice date 31 October. We delivered and installed on 28 October. UK VAT, full VAT invoice. 20% on both lines, prices exclude VAT, rounded on each line. NT- with the year, then a number. Net 30, pounds, no PO. I add the bank details myself, from our bank's letter.

messages.label: Checked the workspace and the company file
rows: Northbrook Trading Ltd, confirmed by name
No tool. A person enters the invoice
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: Here is my plan. I prepare **one invoice** from **Northbrook Trading Ltd** to **Harbor Retail Ltd**, dated **31 October**, under **UK VAT** with the full VAT invoice fields. I read the books from your MosoFin connection. I leave the bank details for you to add from your bank's letter. I cannot create the invoice in your accounting system. You get a draft and a proposed entry. Shall I start?

messages.label: Read the books in one batch
rows: Northbrook Trading Ltd, legal name and address
Name, address, VAT number and Net 30
Sales: products, Sales: services, VAT payable
messages.summary: 13 reads in one batch. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: The next number is **NT-2026-0418**. It is proposed, not reserved. Two things need your answer before the invoice goes out:
messages.after: Is £65.00 the price you agreed, or a keying error? At 6 hours, the difference is £60.00. And which date is the tax point? It decides the VAT period.

messages.text: £65 is the agreed price for this job. The tax point is 28 October.
Thank you. Here is the arithmetic. VAT on each line and VAT on the subtotal give the same £438.00, so there is no rounding difference:
messages.after: The total is more than £250, so UK rules need a full VAT invoice. The draft shows both names and addresses, Harbor's VAT number, the tax point and the date of issue.

messages.text: You delivered both lines on 28 October, before the invoice date. So the entry credits sales, not deferred revenue:
messages.after: Your system makes this entry when a person enters the invoice. The receivable equals the amount due on the invoice.

messages.text: I also checked your recent numbers, **NT-2026-0390 to NT-2026-0417**, with the voided invoices. Two numbers need a look:

card.title: Number check
head: Finding
Number
What it means
rows: Not in the books, not voided

messages.after: A missing number usually means that someone deleted an invoice. Only your system's audit log can show that. I cannot read it.

messages.text: The invoice is marked as a draft for review. The payment block is empty, for your bank details. Before you send it, check that Harbor's VAT number is still current. I do not create or send the invoice.
messages.after: Do you want the draft as a PDF? If so, which file name do you want?

messages.text: Yes. Call it NT-2026-0418 Harbor Retail.pdf
Here is **NT-2026-0418 Harbor Retail.pdf**, marked as a draft. Do you want me to save your settings for the next invoice?

Done. For Northbrook Trading Ltd, I saved the UK field list, your numbering scheme and your account map. I never save tax IDs, bank details or invoice contents. I read the next number again on every run.

chosen.NT-2026-0418 Harbor Retail.pdf: the file name that the user gives for the PDF draft, when the agent asks for it
